end.parentNote: Asha used example and cause-and-effect questions to practise how traditional practices protect trees, birds and soil. Dev gave the Chipko example and linked trees with holding soil, but the link between traditional knowledge and science is still being built. The mix-up that old practices are separate from science remained at the end. At home, ask Dev to choose one traditional practice and say what could be observed to test how it helps nature.
